_comment: English body for prompt-case-slides-brief. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output per-slide title, points, source and checks; do not exaggerate effects.
Inputs: Topic, materials, slide limit, and audience.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Generate a brief of at most {slides} slides. Each slide outputs title, points[], source and check. points must come from {materials}; check states how the reader verifies the slide. Do not write best/strongest/percentage uplift unless the source states it with its measurement basis.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.预期输出形态: slides[] with source and verification method per slide.
sections.检查点:
- Each slide has a source for points.
- No comparison words without measurement basis.
- Slide count stays under the limit.
sections.失败分支:
- Too dense: split slides or remove secondary items.
- Missing source: mark a gap or remove the slide.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
